card.name: The ending -ed after vent and melt
card.fires_on: The ending "ed" completing "vent" in "vented" (vented spike, vented set, vented vial adapter). It also fires on "ed" in "Melted".

modes.label: Vented equipment
modes.description: The ending "ed" after "vent" in infusion sets, spikes and vial adapters.
modes.example: Insert a vent<<ed>> intravenous spike set through the stopper

modes.label: Melted product
modes.description: The ending "ed" after "Melt" in a preparation warning.

modes.label: Vented roof
modes.description: The same "vent" plus "ed" outside medicine, in building text.
modes.example: Black asphalt shingles with a vent<<ed>> double roof deck
